questions.stem: Which of the following statements is incorrect about tonsils?

options.label: A
options.text: Bed of the tonsil is formed by the superior constrictor and styloglossus muscles.

options.label: B
options.text: It is covered by keratinizing stratified squamous epithelium on the medial surface.

options.label: C
options.text: Crypta magna is a remnant of the ventral part of second pharyngeal pouch.

options.label: D
options.text: A capsule covers the lateral surface of the tonsils.
